comment: The knob at row k and column j sets what input k contributes to output j, X8.cpp:87, and each of the sixty-four modulation jacks belongs to one of those knobs. The modulation multiplies rather than adds, X8.cpp:86-87, which is the opposite of X6 and X4. Connections are checked once every 32 samples, X8.cpp:60. Switching biPolar on rewrites the range of all sixty-four knobs and keeps their values, X8.cpp:26-48. The signal inputs and outputs get no family because they carry whatever is patched in.
